Tables in the `jira` schema, populated by the daily PSOM Jira Service
Management sync pipeline.

Each day at ~06:00 ET, the `psom-sync` Lambda fetches a full snapshot of all
tickets from the PSOM project (`jtickets.atlassian.net`) and writes it as three
Parquet partitions in S3: one for tickets, one for their SLA clocks, and one
for their comments. A single Glue crawler then updates all three Athena tables.
Join them on `key` and `date`. Before 2026-09-29 the snapshot ran weekly, on
Mondays.
